questions.q: In 'The Boy and the Filberts', why couldn't the Boy get his hand out of the pitcher?

The pitcher was too small for any hand
His hand was stuck in honey

questions.evidence: he took such a great fistful that he could not draw his hand out again

choices: Do not attempt too much at once
Always share your food
Never cry about anything
Nuts are bad for you
questions.evidence: Do not attempt too much at once.
